name: Material preparation
function: Prepared veneer lots and dimensional characterization
purchased_hardware: caliper; approved wet-material process; labeled trays
acceptance_gate: wet/dry width; thickness; break tension; dry geometry recorded before automation

name: Feed + tension
purchased_hardware: 608/623 bearings; spring; felt/PTFE; 1 kg load cell + HX711
acceptance_gate: 20 consecutive feeds without snag; tension stays inside validated band

name: Synchronized winder
purchased_hardware: 2x NEMA17; 2x A4988; T8x8 screw; 2x 8 mm rods; LM8UU; metal 0.8 mm mandrel; mini chuck
acceptance_gate: 20 consecutive bodies; no skipped steps; exact turn count; acceptable pitch/gap/overlap

name: Clamp + cut
function: Hold inactive region and cut sacrificial stock
purchased_hardware: micro servo; purchased spring-return shear; silicone jaw liner

name: Tail forming
purchased_hardware: micro servos; split former hardware; soft liner
acceptance_gate: tails release wet without tearing and dry into repeatable assembly envelope

name: Seed + tip assembly
function: Index one seed; align 3 tails; dispense adhesive/tip material
purchased_hardware: 28BYJ-48 x2; ULN2003 x2; syringe; species-specific seed disk; non-stick mold insert
acceptance_gate: one seed; 3 tails; no adhesive on active coils; tip survives handling; viability acceptable

name: Free drying
purchased_hardware: USB fan; PTFE/silicone mesh; optional temp/RH sensor
acceptance_gate: repeatable dry geometry; no fixture-induced flattening

name: Vision QA
purchased_hardware: RealSense or fixed camera; LED ring
acceptance_gate: validated labeled dataset; heartbeat fail-safe; documented false accept/reject

name: XY transfer
function: Move fixtures/parts between stations after stations are proven
purchased_hardware: donor 3D-printer gantry or 2020/GT2; NEMA17 x2; servo Z/gripper
controller: separate motion node or extended controller

name: Drone cassette - optional downstream
function: Release one finished carrier at a time
purchased_hardware: proven aircraft; flight controller; Pi/companion; RP2040; 4 servos
acceptance_gate: bench release validation; mass/CG/thrust margin; fail-closed gates; permissions
